name: Lyrics 2
tagline: Find, read and save locally your favourite songs' lyrics!
blurb: Lyrics 2 is a lyrics finder and reader.
description:
Lyrics 2 is a lyrics finder and reader.
You can search any song's lyrics by author, title or if you simply remember a few words of the song.
Or you can search the song you are listening to on your device!
Once you found your lyrics, you can save them locally.

Lyrics 2 uses Genius and ChartLyrics search services.
